name: select
title: Select
description: A non-modal select primitive for app forms, filters, settings, and onboarding flows. It includes field, filled, and pill trigger variants, labels, hints, error state, disabled state, disabled options, grouped options, option descriptions, leading/trailing slots, and controlled/uncontrolled state.
author: Wensity <hello@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/select.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add select.
